scenes.text: In 2014, a family bought their dream house in New Jersey. Six bedrooms. A quiet street.
Three days later, a letter came. Addressed to: the new owner.
657 Boulevard has been the subject of my family for decades.
Who am I? I am The Watcher.
More letters came. The Watcher knew they had kids. And it wanted their names.
Once I know their names, I will call to them, and draw them to me.

lines: what is in the walls yet?

scenes.text: Have they found out what is in the walls yet?
The family never spent a single night in that house. And The Watcher was never caught.
So... when did you last check your mailbox?
